main.description: Joining a group, or following one thread within it. Forked from site.standard.graph.subscription and made granular: group alone means joining the whole group (space), and adding thread narrows the subscription to that thread and everything nested under it (a channel, a forum thread, or an article's comments). Written by the subscriber. Unsubscribing deletes the record, and changing notify updates it in place.

group.description: The community.lexicon.thread.group being joined, or a site.standard.publication when following comments on one of its articles.

thread.description: Narrows the subscription to this community.lexicon.thread.thread and everything under it: its posts and its child threads, at any depth. To follow a channel, point at the channel's thread, not its community.lexicon.thread.channel record. Can also be a site.standard.document, to follow the comments on an article. Only counts when the thread belongs to the group.

notify.description: What the subscriber wants to hear about. posts: every new post and thread in scope. threads: new threads only. none: follow without notifications, such as keeping a channel in the sidebar. Absent means threads for a whole group and posts for a thread. Apps choose how to deliver it (feed, badge, push or email).
